metadata.title: Weak Lie 3-groups, 2-gerbes over torus fibrations of type F1, and T-Duality
metadata.abstract: We construct a weak Lie 3-group $T_2 \mathbb B^{F_1}_n$ from the 2-category of gerbes over $\mathbb R^n / \mathbb Z^n$ and the $\mathbb R^n/ \mathbb Z^n$-action on it by pullback along translations. We also construct a homotopy equivalence between $T_2 \mathbb B^{F_1}_n$ and a different Lie 3-group $T_2 \mathbb D^{F_1}_n$, which admits a dimensional reduction to the homotopy equivalence of Lie 2-groups introduced by Nikolaus and Waldorf to model half-geometric T-duality. This is a first step towards establishing a higher form of T-duality for 2-gerbes over torus fibrations, relevant to supergravity and M-theory.

analysis.workSummary: 从环面上的 gerbe 二范畴与平移拉回作用构造弱 Lie 三群，给出与另一模型的同伦等价及降维联系。
analysis.breakthrough: 把半几何 T-对偶的 Lie 二群模型推进到更高层结构。
analysis.limitations: 作者将其定位为高阶 T-对偶的第一步，尚非完整 2-gerbe 对偶理论。 本条基于已检查来源的阅读分析，关键结论请回查原文。 研究结论仅作摘要级分析，未独立核验证明。
analysis.priorityReason: 适合高阶几何与数学物理研究者，对本课题组度量方向关联较弱。
